title: Archicad parity certification
objective: Certify integrated Archicad-class BIM and documentation workflows against a representative professional workflow corpus without changing ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: A representative Archicad-class BIM/documentation workflow corpus is defined and version-pinned before certification evidence is produced.
Representative workflows pass BIM/document semantics and behavioral-fidelity assessment against declared reference behavior.
Representative workflows pass persistence and document round-trip durability assessment with deterministic canonical identities and lineage.
Representative workflows are completed through real Web/Electron UI paths rather than API-only mocks.
Interoperability is assessed with explicit EXACT, LOSSY and UNSUPPORTED outcomes and no fabricated semantics.
Performance and robustness are assessed against declared corpus-specific targets and recorded as revision-bound evidence.
Feature checklist presence alone is explicitly insufficient for certification.
The certified workflow remains consistent with the P019 baseline wherever shared CAD semantics and infrastructure are involved.
Construction Graph, CADDocument, App API, command registry and native engine/worker boundaries remain unchanged and respected.
Certification evidence is reproducible, revision-bound and sufficient for an Architect VERIFIED decision.
non_goals: Claiming unrestricted or perfect Archicad/Revit parity.
Adding unrelated features solely to increase checklist coverage.
Changing Architecture v1.1 without an Architecture Change Request.
Replacing the Construction Graph or CADDocument authority model.
Bypassing the established engine adapter or worker boundary.
risk_assumptions: P019 is VERIFIED before P020 execution.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout certification.
Reference BIM/documentation workflow expectations are documented and reproducible enough to support certification claims.
The P019-certified shared workflow infrastructure remains the baseline where applicable.
evidence_requirements: Version-pinned representative Archicad-class BIM/documentation workflow corpus and reference expectations.
Deterministic BIM semantic-fidelity results for the declared corpus.
Persistence and document round-trip evidence for representative workflows.
Interop evidence with explicit EXACT/LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED classification.
Regression proof over P019 and earlier verified CAD/BIM baselines.
Exact-head CI verification and deployment/browser evidence where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering certification implementation, review and final verification.

transitions.label: declare_ready
transitions.reason: P019 is VERIFIED, issue #123 is fully specified with objective, scope, acceptance criteria, non-goals, dependency, architecture constraints and revision-bound evidence requirements; it is eligible for assignment under the repository lifecycle.

transitions.label: assign
